records.title: outer shows four resize handles and rotate handle
outer resize scales both children and writes group once
outer rotation snaps to 15 degrees with Shift
bag s01 resize and rotate persist on bag only
plain leaf rotate writes rotate once
resize leaf inside rotated g1 preserves rotation and uniform ratio
Esc during group resize restores live pose without write
existing group drag retains exact translation
